name: NCAA D-III Niagara Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-III Niagara Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: No. 1 NYU women and No. 13 SUNY Geneseo women; No. 4 SUNY Geneseo and No. 8 NYU men. Nationals bids are on the line for the NCAA D-III Championships on Nov. 21 in Northfield, Minn.
